party.title: Party Builder

party.resetConfirm: Reset your party? All saved data will be cleared.
party.notInRegulation: Not allowed in the current regulation

formNote.palafinhero: On = Hero Form, off = Zero Form (when it first comes in). In practice it fights as Hero Form after switching out once, so it is on by default. The battle screen switches automatically.
formNote.aegislashblade: On = stats and damage taken while in Blade Forme (after it attacked first in the same turn). Its own attacks always use Blade Forme either way.
formNote.morpekohangry: On = Hangry Mode: Aura Wheel becomes Dark-type (Electric in Full Belly Mode). Base stats are the same. The battle screen switches it every turn.
formNote.castform: Castform's form follows the weather (Sunny = sun, Rainy = rain, Snowy = snow). Clicking one switches the weather used for the calculation.
formNote.mimikyubusted: On = Disguise already broken. Off = the first hit is blocked and it takes only 1/8 of max HP.

consistency.none: No attacking type hits every Pokémon for 1× or more.

battle.pickActive: Choose the Pokémon to send out
battle.errDealt: Damage dealt must be between 0 and 100%
battle.errTaken: Damage taken must be between 0 and {max} (my max HP)
battle.orderPriorityFixed: Different move priority decides the order — unrelated to Speed
battle.orderSpeedFixed: Speed already decides the order (opponent {span}, mine {my})
battle.orderRequired: Speed doesn't settle the move order — pick who actually moved first before applying
battle.spreadKoHint: The opponent's spread (nature and SP) is inferred only from damage dealt and taken. Left = the spread most favorable to the attacker, right = least favorable
battle.oppStatHint: The opponent's stats are the range inferred from damage and move order (the nature and SP on the team preview are not used). HP % is converted using the middle of the range
battle.orderSwitchFixed: Switching always goes before moves — unrelated to Speed
battle.orderBothSwitch: Both switched: pick who withdrew first to narrow the outgoing opponent's Speed range
battle.entryOrderHint: The order in which the abilities (weather, terrain, Intimidate, …) of Pokémon that entered at the same time were announced. The faster one activates first (reversed in Trick Room) and the later weather/terrain stays. Choosing re-applies weather/terrain and narrows the opponent's Speed range
battle.entryUnknown: Can't tell from Speed — pick the message that appeared first (applied by the estimated set for now)
battle.replaceHint: The Pokémon chosen by both sides enter together. Switch-in abilities activate in Speed order (you can correct the order in the action panel).
battle.errReplace: Choose replacements for fainted Pokémon first

result.win: Victory — all opposing Pokémon have fainted
result.lose: Defeat — all of your Pokémon have fainted
result.draw: Draw — all Pokémon on both sides have fainted

flow.switchTurn: Switches happen first, so turn order isn't forecast for this turn.
flow.speedTie: {a} and {b} have the same Speed — turn order is random.
flow.koSure: → {name} is guaranteed to faint and can't act.
flow.koMaybe: → Not a guaranteed OHKO; assuming {name} survives. (see ②)
flow.koSureIf: → If it hits first, {name} is guaranteed to faint.
flow.koMaybeIf: → If it hits first, {name} may faint depending on the roll and the opponent's spread.
flow.scenarioFirstOpp: The opponent moves first in this scenario, so it depends on their move.
flow.scenarioStatus: {move} doesn't deal damage, so this can't be judged.
flow.subSure: → {name}'s substitute (HP {hp}) breaks. The Pokémon itself takes no damage.
flow.subMaybe: → {name}'s substitute (HP {hp}) may break depending on the roll. The Pokémon itself takes no damage.
flow.subNo: → {name}'s substitute (HP {hp}) takes the hit and stays.
flow.orderSure: ※ Order confirmed by Speed (opponent {span}, you {my} · from observed move order and confirmed item).
flow.orderSureTie: ※ Opponent Speed {span}, you {my} — a Speed tie is possible, in which case the order is random.
flow.orderUnknown: ※ Opponent Speed {span} overlaps your {my}, so the order is unknown. Pick the actual order under "Turn order".
flow.orderUnknownPlain: ※ The move order is unknown. Pick the actual order under "Turn order".
flow.orderRandom: ※ Quick Claw (also possible while the opponent's item is unconfirmed) or Quick Draw can change the order.
flow.subMaybeP: → {name}'s substitute (HP {hp}) breaks with {p}% chance. The Pokémon itself takes no damage.
flow.subMulti: → {name}'s substitute (HP {hp}) takes the hits first; once it breaks, the remaining hits hit the Pokémon ({p}% chance to break).

battle.focusHint: Analysis below uses the selected Pokémon on each side

formHint.palafinhero: Becomes Hero Form after switching out once (applied automatically)
formHint.aegislashblade: Blade Forme after an attacking move, Shield Forme after King's Shield or switching out (applied automatically). Attacks are always calculated in Blade Forme
formHint.morpekohangry: Switches between Full Belly and Hangry Mode at the end of every turn (automatic). Aura Wheel is Electric in Full Belly Mode and Dark in Hangry Mode
formHint.mimikyubusted: Disguise breaks after being hit once (automatic). Before that, the first hit is blocked and it takes only 1/8 of max HP

battle.itemGoneHint: Click to mark the item as used/lost (Focus Sash, berries, Knock Off...). Resist berries and Air Balloon are handled automatically when damage is entered
battle.errAlly: Ally damage is out of range (yours: 0 to max HP, opponent: 0-100%)
battle.transformHint: Transform into the opposing Pokémon across (Imposter does this on entry). Copies species, types, ability, moves, stats (not HP) and stat stages; keeps its own item and HP — the target's Choice item boost is not copied
battle.speedHint: Mark who moved first in the action panel and apply the turn — ranges that don't fit are removed. Ignored when the moves' priorities differ.
battle.speedHintNarrowed: Narrowed by observed move order (S = remaining stat points). Speed-lowering natures are not covered.

verdict.none: Fits no case — maybe a −Spe nature, another item or ability

battle.critHint: Check if this hit was a critical hit (used for the opponent estimate)

est.title: Opponent estimate
est.transformed: Transformed — its stats are copied, so nothing to estimate.
est.infeasible: No spread fits the inputs — check item, ability, critical hit and damage
est.scarfRuledOut: A damage-boosting item is confirmed → no Choice Scarf
est.note: Narrows each time a turn is applied. Damage dealt is checked against the before/after HP % (the game rounds down), damage taken allows ±1 HP, and correcting end-of-turn HP to the game value narrows HP; multi-hit, fixed-damage moves and turns with a hit-triggered item are skipped. Uses the entered ability. Battle damage tables and the expected flow also use this range instead of the nature and SP on the team preview.

battle.disguiseHint: Disguise: blocks the first hit and takes only 1/8 of max HP (counted in KO hits). Ignored by Mold Breaker
battle.missedHint: Check if the move missed or failed: no damage, crash damage (1/2 max HP) for High Jump Kick etc., and Stomping Tantrum / Temper Flare double next turn
battle.foeSwitch: Opponent switched in after the hit
battle.editModeHint: When on, changing the Pokémon on the field is not treated as a switch (no hazards, entry abilities or switch-out effects) — it just fixes the state. Fix HP, stages and status as needed
battle.editModeBanner: Correction mode: clicking a benched Pokémon (your side) or a revealed/candidate Pokémon (opponent) swaps the field Pokémon without any effects. Turn it off when done.

battle.cantHint: Choose when the Pokémon could not use a move (asleep, frozen, fully paralyzed, etc.; no damage). Asleep/frozen keeps this as the default next turn; choose "Use move" when it wakes up or thaws and the status is cleared. For confusion self-hits or other, enter the HP lost (yours in HP, the opponent in %)
battle.drainAfterHint: Your HP right after the drain message (Life Orb etc. come after). If entered, it is used instead of the calculated heal, and the HP the opponent actually lost is worked back from the heal to narrow the opponent's HP spread. Leave empty to use the calculation
battle.faintsFirst: It is hit first and surely faints, so it can't move this turn (re-judged if you pick a priority move)
battle.sleepNoWake: It can't wake up this time (first attempt after falling asleep, up to the second with Rest) — unless it's Sleep Talk or Snore, the move is not applied and counts as unable to move (asleep)
battle.hpModeHint: When on, enter HP before → after the hit instead of the damage (the difference is the damage). Leave "before" empty to use the current HP. Opponent in %, yours in HP
battle.hpBefore: HP before the hit (empty = current HP)
battle.pctRangeHint: The game shows opponent HP % rounded down, so the actual damage is somewhere in this range. Stat estimation checks the damage possible from the before/after %
battle.hpCheckHint: If the end-of-turn HP (sandstorm, Leftovers, etc.) differs from the game, enter the game value. It is used to estimate the opponent HP stat
battle.spHint: Stat points (for the opponent, the range matching the estimated stat — includes every nature effect when unknown)
battle.abilityConfirmHint: Pick the opponent's ability once it is revealed (switch-in message, ability activation). It is saved as confirmed for this battle only (the opponent's team on the team preview screen stays the same). If the Pokémon just came in, its switch-in effect (Intimidate, weather, terrain) is applied now. An Intimidate already applied from a wrong guess is not undone — fix the stat stages by hand. Clear to unconfirm
battle.abilityGuessHint: Calculated with the ability from the team preview screen (auto-fill etc.) — a guess
battle.itemConfirmHint: Pick the opponent's item if it was revealed this turn (Leftovers recovery, White Herb, resist berry, extended terrain from Terrain Extender, etc.). It is saved as confirmed for this battle only (the opponent's team preview stays unchanged) and is used in calculations and end-of-turn effects from this turn. Before confirmation, the team preview item is shown only as a guess. Clear it to cancel
battle.subTarget: Hits the substitute (sub HP {hp}) — the Pokémon’s HP is unchanged
battle.errSelf: HP lost while unable to move is out of range (mine: 0–max HP, opponent: 0–100%)
battle.switchBlocked: Cannot switch (trapped, Shadow Tag or Fairy Lock). Pivot moves like U-turn still work
battle.subHint: The substitute takes the hit first (sub HP {hp}). KO hits include breaking the substitute; damage beyond the sub's HP is lost
battle.guessHint: The opponent's item from the team preview (auto-fill, usage stats or manual) is a guess and is not used in the main result. This is the result if it holds that item. Once revealed, pick it under "Confirm opponent item"
battle.itemGuessHint: Item from the team preview (a guess). Battle calculations only use items confirmed via "Confirm opponent item"
battle.contactInflict: Contact → inflicted on the attacker by {ability}
battle.contactInflictMine: Contact → inflicted on your Pokémon by the opponent's {ability}
battle.encoreLocked: Encored: it can only use {move} ({n} turn(s) incl. this one)
battle.ppHint: Moves and remaining PP (an opposing Pressure uses 1 more; copied moves have 5 PP while transformed)
battle.ppHintOpp: Moves the opponent used or called with Sleep Talk this battle (confirmed) and remaining PP. ? = not yet known
battle.amountWarn: ⚠ Outside the expected range {min}–{max}{unit}. Check item, ability, crit and stat stages (you can still apply the turn)

help.title: Help
help.flow1: On the Party screen, set ability, nature, item, Stat Points and moves for your 6 Pokémon. Everything is saved in your browser.
help.flow2: On Singles or Doubles Team Preview, enter the opponent's 6 Pokémon and tap yours to set the bring order.
help.flow3: On the Battle screen, enter each turn's actions and results; HP, stat stages and field effects are tracked for you.
help.calc1: Level 50, IVs 31. HP = base + SP + 75; other stats = (base + SP + 20) × nature.
help.calc2: Damage follows the Gen 9 formula (power, stats, STAB, type matchup, weather, terrain, crits, items, abilities) with 16 random rolls (85–100%) for KO chances.
help.calc3: Spread moves that hit multiple targets in doubles deal 0.75×.
help.data1: Pokémon, move and item data: Pokémon Showdown (Champions mod); localized names: PokeAPI
help.data2: Images: Pokémon Champions in-game sprites (Bulbagarden Archives)
help.limits1: Some special ability or item effects may not be reflected in calculations.
help.limits2: Moves marked * next to PP use an estimated Champions PP value.
help.flow4: In battle, enter who moved first and the damage dealt and taken; the opponent's speed (Scarf / nature) and bulk and attack spreads narrow down every turn.
help.flow5: The Stats Table lets you search and compare bulk, the best attack of each type, and speed tiers (with Scarf, Tailwind, Sticky Web and abilities) for every allowed Pokémon.

perf.title: Pokémon Stats Table
perf.sub: {n} Pokémon allowed in {reg} (Mega Evolutions included) · Level 50

power.note: Attack index = power × Atk (SpA) stat × STAB × ability (no item, Mega Evolutions hold their Mega Stone, no weather or terrain). A/C = Attack SP for physical moves, Special Attack SP for special moves (Body Press uses Defense). Moves with a drawback unchecked above are never picked; if the picked move has a drawback, the best drawback-free move that never misses is shown below it. Abilities are chosen to maximise the index and shown only when they matter (Skill Link = always 5 hits). Multi-hit moves with a random hit count show the expected value by hit-count probability (top) and min–max (bottom), assuming the move hits: 2–5 hits are 35/35/15/15%, Population Bomb and Triple Axel check accuracy again from the second hit. Moves that use the target's stats (Foul Play) or whose power depends on the target (weight, HP, …) are excluded.

bulk.note: Bulk index = HP stat × Def (SpD) stat ÷ 0.411 (same formula as the Party screen). H = HP, B = Def, D = SpD SP; nature = a Def (SpD) boosting nature. The stage applies to Def and SpD. No ability or item modifiers.

speed.legend: S = Speed SP, nature = Speed-boosting nature, Scarf = Choice Scarf ×1.5 (— for Mega Evolutions, which hold their Mega Stone). Ability rows assume the condition is met (Swift Swim, Chlorophyll, Sand Rush, Slush Rush, Surge Surfer, Unburden ×2; Quick Feet ×1.5; Speed Boost +1 stage). Unburden is not combined with Scarf.

perf.rangeHint: For multi-hit moves with a random hit count: top = expected value by hit-count probability, bottom = min–max
perf.loadedDiceHint: Calculated as if holding Loaded Dice: 2–5 hit moves hit 4 or 5 times (50% each), Population Bomb 4–10 times, Triple Axel all 3 hits. Not applied to Mega Evolutions (they hold a Mega Stone). Acrobatics loses its no-item doubling.

dex.sub: {n} Pokémon allowed in {reg} (incl. Mega Evolutions) · Level 50
dex.abilityFixed: Mega Evolutions have a fixed ability
dex.typeBulkHint: Bulk ÷ damage multiplier taken (ability immunities and modifiers included). A resist berry doubles it for its type. Neutral types are omitted
dex.movesNote: Accuracy: accuracy stage, Compound Eyes, Hustle and Wide Lens applied (no target evasion). Attack index: power × Atk (SpA) × STAB × ability × item (Atk/SpA stages applied, multi-hit moves use the expected value, status moves —). Usage: share of teams using this Pokémon that ran the move (0.5%+)
